- Constructive Lean 4 Init spans with 0 axioms and 0 private declarations; strong inverse interchange chiInv requires FImageIsPullback or universal bcMap bijectivity across observer families (E : F.obj H.W -> Type, v : F.obj K.W), while FiberViabilitySplit rules out sound and complete macro predicates.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Abstract finite-span pullback theorems and C2 parity witnesses never verify that an actual distributed software system, social institution, or learned representation realizes a given SpanFunctor or Beck-Chevalley condition (Rule 2).
- Formalizes discrete Type spans and finite-step traces; weak infinite bicategories, continuous-time flows, and probabilistic TV distance floors belong outside (the TV bounds live separately in periphery ObservationalFidelity).
- **Counterexample:** EmergentCrossSeamWitness (chiZeroToOne_not_surjective, chiTwoToFour_not_surjective), C2RelativeLossWitness (c2_chi_two_to_one, c2_n_step_collapse), and bc_empty_family_trivial_counterexample (all keeping Becoming.OplaxHistory.* namespace names).
